newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks gain 2.23 pct on rate cut, Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks gain 2.23 pct on rate cut, Wall St.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed sharply higher on Tuesday after a 25 basis point key rate cut this morning and a surge on Wall Street after benign inflation data this afternoon, dealers said.
The general index added 2.23 percent, 10.63 points, to 487.07 while the Ibex-35 blue chip index rose 133.29 points, 2.44 percent, to 5,585.85.
Good economic data in Spain underpinned the gains, with analysts predicting fresh cuts in interest rates later this year.
